core_obligations: E^• ⊗ F = E^• ⊗^L F for every O_X-module F, so E^{a-2} ⊗ F → E^{a-1} ⊗ F → E^a ⊗ F is exact in the middle (proof lines 12329-12336).

The sequence E^{a-2} → E^{a-1} → E^a → Coker(d^{a-1}) → 0 is a flat resolution, whence Tor_1^{O_X}(Coker(d^{a-1}), F) = 0 for all F; conclude Coker(d^{a-1}) is flat by the flat-tor-zero lemma (proof lines 12337-12347).
proof_roadmap: Vanish Tor_1 for every test module.
difficulty_reason: Since E^• is a bounded above complex of flat modules, ordinary and derived tensor agree; middle exactness of the tensored sequence gives Tor_1(Coker(d^{a-1}), F) = 0 for all F, which characterizes flatness.
